displayName.zh: 巴塔哥尼亚冬季与美洲狮追踪

summary.en: Pumas are more active and come lower down the mountains in winter. Encounters are frequent on tracking tours.
summary.zh: 美洲狮在冬季更活跃，且会下到更低的山区。在追踪行程中遭遇非常频繁。

mitigations.en: Never run. Maintain eye contact. Do not crouch.
mitigations.zh: 绝对不要跑。保持眼神接触。不要蹲下。

mitigations.en: Always stay with your guide. Solo hiking in puma territory in winter is risky.
mitigations.zh: 始终跟随向导。冬季在美洲狮领地独自徒步是有风险的。

summary.en: Most 'Refugios' (hostels) and campsites are CLOSED in winter. Public transport buses cease operation.
summary.zh: 大多数 'Refugios'（旅舍）和露营地在冬季关闭。公共交通巴士停止运营。

mitigations.en: You must stay in the few open hotels (e.g., Explora, Tierra) or arrange private logistics.
mitigations.zh: 必须入住少数开放的酒店（如 Explora, Tierra）或安排私人后勤。

mitigations.en: Hiking the 'W' trek in winter often requires a mandatory hired guide by regulation.
mitigations.zh: 根据规定，冬季徒步 'W' 线通常需要强制雇佣向导。

items.en: Micro-spikes or Crampons (Trails are icy/packed snow).
items.zh: 微型冰爪或全齿冰爪（小径结冰/积雪压实）。

items.en: Gaiters (To keep snow out of boots in deep drifts).
items.zh: 雪套（防止深雪灌入靴子）。

items.en: Binoculars (Essential for spotting Pumas camouflage against rocks).
items.zh: 双筒望远镜（在岩石背景中发现伪装的美洲狮必不可少）。

message.en: Patagonian wind is legendary (up to 120km/h). In winter, this creates extreme wind chill. Secure all gear. Lean into the wind when walking.
message.zh: 巴塔哥尼亚的风是传奇级的（最高可达 120km/h）。在冬季，这会产生极端的风寒效应。固定好所有装备。行走时身体迎风倾斜。
